DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお尋ねになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あの犬がかわいくて、触りたいです。公園を散歩している犬なら、近づいてなでてもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園にいる犬へ自由に触れてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: That dog is adorable, and I would like to pet it. If a dog is being walked in the park, may I approach and stroke it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may freely touch a dog in the park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのスタッフが飼い主の代わりに許可することはできません。まず飼い主の方へご希望を尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Our staff cannot give permission on the owner's behalf. Please ask the owner about your wishes first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。かわいいと思ったので、相手も喜ぶと思い込んでいました。まだ触ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 好意が相手にも歓迎されると思ったが未接触と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. Because I thought the dog was cute, I assumed the other party would welcome it too. I have not touched it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed your affection would be welcome but have not touched the dog. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 断られた場合は、そのご希望を尊重してください。犬の様子をこちらで保証することもできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If they decline, please respect their wishes. We cannot guarantee how the dog will behave either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。「触ってもよいですか」と先に尋ねます。返事がないまま、写真を撮るふりで近づくこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飼い主へ先に許可を尋ね返事前に近づかないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will first ask, “May I pet your dog?” I will not approach before receiving an answer, even while pretending to take a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the owner for permission first and will not approach before an answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように、ご本人へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check directly with the person in that way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飼い主の方から、今日は触らないでほしいと言われました。残念ですが、理由を何度も聞いて説得しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 触らない希望を受け理由を重ねて聞いて説得しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The owner told me they do not want anyone touching the dog today. I am disappointed, but I will not repeatedly ask why to persuade them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you accept their wish not to have the dog touched and will not repeatedly ask why to persuade them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を聞けましたね。別の場所でご自身の散歩を続けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You have heard their wishes. You can continue your own walk elsewhere.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。触れなくても、少し離れて見られてうれしかったです。自分が犬好きなことを許可の代わりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 好意を許可とせず離れた観察後自分の散歩を続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Even without petting it, I was happy to watch from a little distance. I will not treat my love of dogs as permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not treat affection as permission and will continue your own walk after watching from a distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご理解ありがとうございます。それでは、ご自身の散歩もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for understanding. Please enjoy your own walk too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お困りのことがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you need help with something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同行の友人だけが乗車し、私は駅に残りました。券の情報も友人がまとめて持っているので、次にどうすればよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人だけ乗車し自分は残り券情報も友人が持つと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only my friend boarded, and I stayed at the station. My friend also has both our ticket details, so I would like advice on what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only your friend boarded, you stayed behind, and your friend has the ticket details. Ask for advice in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様ご本人は乗車していないのですね。友人の方と連絡を取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You yourself have not boarded, correct? Can you contact your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 連絡できます。荷物は自分で持っています。友人が先に乗ったことを、私も乗ったという意味にはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人未乗車で連絡可能かつ荷物は自分の手元と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can. I have my luggage with me. Please do not take my friend boarding first to mean that I boarded too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not boarded, can contact your friend, and have your luggage with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の券の情報を確認する必要があります。担当の案内に沿って、友人の方へ必要な確認をお願いできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check your own ticket details. Following the responsible staff member's guidance, you can ask your friend to check what is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。二人分をまとめた画面をそのまま渡すのでなく、どの情報が私の分か確かめてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へまとめ画面のうち本人分を確かめるよう頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than simply sending the screen with both our tickets, I will ask my friend to check which details are mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your friend to identify your own details on the combined screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今後の乗車や券の取扱いは、確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain subsequent travel and ticket handling after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人には次の駅で必ず待ってほしいと、駅員さんの案内として伝えたりはしません。まず状況を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅員未案内の合流指示を友人へ職員の指示として伝えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will not tell my friend that station staff instructed them to wait at the next station without fail. I will first explain the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not present a reunion instruction that station staff have not given as a staff instruction to your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流の予定も、ご案内を確認してからお互いにご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss plans to meet each other after confirming the guidance as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。友人は乗車済み、私は駅にいると分けて伝え、本人の券を確認してから次の移動と合流を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の現在状況を分け券確認後に移動と合流を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will explain separately that my friend is already on board and I am at the station, then consider further travel and meeting up after checking my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish your current situations and consider travel and meeting up after checking your ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へおつなぎします。それでは、こちらで案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer you to the responsible staff member with those details. Please wait here for guidance. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アンケートの書き方について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about how to fill out the survey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 対応が親切だったので四を選びました。でも、下には四が不満とあります。数字が大きいほど良いと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 親切を評価して四を選んだが表示は不満と気づいたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The service was kind, so I selected four. But below it says four means dissatisfied. I thought a higher number was better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you selected four to praise the kind service but noticed it is labeled dissatisfied. Ask about this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの用紙は、一が満足、四が不満という表示です。ご自身のお気持ちに合う項目をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this form, one means satisfied and four means dissatisfied. Please select the option that matches how you feel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示を読んでいませんでした。対応には満足したという気持ちなので、その意味に合う一へ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 凡例を見ず高数値を良いと考えたが満足の一に直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had not read the labels. I feel satisfied with the service, so I would like to change it to one, which has that meaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you assumed a higher number was better without reading the key, but want to change it to one for satisfied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回答はご自身のご意見としてお書きください。ほかに伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write your response as your own opinion. Is there anything else you would like to convey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待つ時間は長く感じました。親切だったと答えるなら、その点を書いてはいけないと思っていましたが、別に感想を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待ち時間は長く別の感想として書きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The wait felt long. I thought I should not mention that if I said the service was kind, but I would like to write it as a separate comment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the wait felt long and you would like to write that as a separate comment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自由記入の欄に、具体的に感じたことを残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can leave specific comments about your experience in the free-response box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「説明は親切で助かったが、待ち時間の見通しも分かるとうれしい」と書きます。満足の数字だけで全部の気持ちを表さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 親切な説明への感謝と待ち時間の見通し希望を文章で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write, “The kind explanation helped me, but I would also appreciate an idea of how long the wait will be.” I will not try to express all my feelings with the satisfaction number alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Express in writing gratitude for the kind explanation and a wish for an estimate of the wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身が伝えたい内容になっているか、提出前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before submitting, please check that it says what you want to convey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。数字の意味を見て選び、待ち時間の意見は文章で分けて書けました。この内容で提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数字の意味と具体的意見を確認して提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked. I selected the number after reading its meaning, and wrote my opinion about the wait separately. I will submit it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the number's meaning and your specific comments and will submit the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご意見をありがとうございます。それでは、こちらへお入れください。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your feedback. Please put it here. Thank you for your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の確認と、今日の体調について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check your appointment and ask about your health today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予防接種を予約しています。ただ、昨日からせきが出ています。せきを話したら予約が無駄になりそうで、言うか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予防接種予約があるが昨日からのせきを話すか迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a vaccination appointment. But I have had a cough since yesterday. I hesitated to mention it because I thought reporting it might make the appointment go to waste.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have a vaccination appointment but hesitated to mention your cough since yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 体調の変化はそのまま教えてください。実施できるかは担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us about any changes in your health as they are. The responsible practitioner will check whether vaccination can proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約した時にはせきはありませんでした。予約があるから、今日の体調も問題ないと考えるのは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約時と今の体調を分け予約だけで問題なしとしないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I did not have a cough when I booked. Having an appointment does not mean that my health today is fine, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your health when booking from your health now, and explain that an appointment alone does not mean everything is fine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約時と今の状態を分けて伺います。今の症状について、ほかに伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask separately about your condition when booking and now. Is there anything else you want to report about your current symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: せきがいつ出たかのメモがあります。ほかの症状は、分かる範囲で質問に答えます。自分で風邪と診断したことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 症状メモを示し他症状は質問に答え自己診断を確定としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note about when the cough started. I will answer questions about other symptoms as far as I know. I will not treat my own diagnosis of a cold as established.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your symptom note, say you will answer questions about other symptoms, and will not treat self-diagnosis as certain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのメモも担当へお見せください。今日の扱いは、確認後にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show that note to the responsible practitioner too. We will explain how today will be handled after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。問診の紙も、予約の時と同じ答えをそのまま写さず、今の状態を伝えるために見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の問診回答を写さず現在の状態で見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will also review the health questionnaire to report my current condition rather than copying the same answers from when I booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will review the questionnaire based on your current condition instead of copying earlier answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 判断を聞いてから、今後のご案内へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hear the decision before proceeding with the next guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。予定を守るためにせきを隠さず、体調の変化と予約内容を伝えて担当に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定を優先して症状を隠さず担当確認を受けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will not hide my cough to keep the schedule. I will report the changes in my health and my appointment details and have the responsible practitioner check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not prioritize your schedule by hiding symptoms and will have the responsible practitioner check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご申告を担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your report to the responsible practitioner. Please wait for guidance. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物の相談について、ほかに確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything else you would like to check about your lost-property inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ遅れた理由を送ります。「警察で取り調べを受けた」と書こうとしましたが、今日の用件の説明として合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ取り調べを受けたと書こうとしたが用件説明として適切か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending my workplace a reason for being late. I was going to write, “I was interrogated by the police,” but is that an accurate description of today's business?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether saying you were interrogated is an appropriate description of your business when writing to your workplace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日伺ったのは、お客様の落とし物のご相談です。その用件と、ご自身が使う言葉を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What we heard today was your inquiry about lost property. Please check both that purpose and the words you use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。事情を聞かれたので、どんな話も取り調べと呼ぶと思っていました。自分がしたのは、なくした物の相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 事情を聞かれること全般を取り調べと思ったが落とし物相談と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. Because I was asked about the circumstances, I thought any conversation like that was called an interrogation. What I did was ask about something I lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought all questioning about circumstances was interrogation, but confirm that this was a lost-property inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職場への連絡は、ご自身で内容をお決めください。こちらで職場の受理をお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please decide for yourself what to tell your workplace. We cannot promise that your workplace will accept it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。「落とし物の相談で警察へ立ち寄った」と書きます。それで遅れが認められるかは、職場と話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 落とし物相談で立ち寄ったと書き職場の扱いは職場へ尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will write, “I stopped at the police station to ask about lost property.” I will discuss with my workplace whether that excuses the delay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will write that you stopped by for a lost-property inquiry and ask your workplace how it will handle your delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 他の方について聞いた情報まで、職場の連絡に入れる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is no need to include information you heard about other people in your workplace message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。用件と自分の到着が遅れることだけ伝えます。相談記録の話を、全部職場へ送るつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他者情報や全相談記録でなく本人用件と遅れだけ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will mention only my business and that my arrival will be delayed. I do not intend to send my workplace everything discussed in the inquiry record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will report only your own business and delay, rather than other people's information or the entire inquiry record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な確認があれば、担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need to check anything, please consult the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。警察へ来た事実を大きな言葉に変えず、落とし物の相談だったと自分で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来訪の事実を大げさな別語にせず自己の言葉で説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will explain in my own words that I came to inquire about lost property, without replacing the fact that I came to the police station with an exaggerated expression.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the visit in your own words without turning the facts into a different, exaggerated term. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日の用件を確認できました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the purpose of today's visit. Please take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お送りになる物と、ご希望を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you want to send and your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ鉢植えを贈りたいです。今週送りたいのですが、友人はしばらく旅行すると言っていたのを思い出しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鉢植えを今週贈りたいが友人の旅行予定を思い出したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to give a friend a potted plant. I would like to send it this week, but I remembered my friend said they would be traveling for a while.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to send a potted plant this week but remembered your friend's travel plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取る方の予定と、物品の発送条件をそれぞれ確認しましょう。お荷物はまだ準備中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the recipient's schedule and the item's shipping conditions separately. Are you still preparing the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ梱包していません。送る時の自分の都合ばかり考えて、友人が受け取って世話をできるか聞いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未梱包で自己都合を優先し受取りや世話の予定を聞いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have not packed it yet. I was thinking only about when it suited me to send it and had not asked whether my friend could receive it and care for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is not packed, you prioritized your convenience, and have not asked about receiving or caring for it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この物品を発送できる方法や条件は、担当が確認します。相手の予定は、ご本人へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff member will check the available shipping methods and conditions for this item. Please ask the recipient about their schedule directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。鉢植えを贈りたい気持ちを伝え、帰宅後なら受け取りたいかも聞きます。留守中でも届けばよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人へ贈物の希望と帰宅後受取意思を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I will tell my friend I would like to give them a potted plant and ask whether they would like to receive it after returning home. I will not assume delivery during their absence is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the recipient about the proposed gift and whether they want to receive it after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認ができてから、発送の時期や準備をご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have checked, you can discuss the shipping date and preparations with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人から、帰ってから受け取りたいと返事がありました。今週すぐ送る予定はやめ、友人が対応できる時期を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅後受取の希望を受け今週の発送を止め時期を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend replied that they would like to receive it after returning home. I will drop my plan to send it immediately this week and check when my friend can manage it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that, in response to their wish to receive it after returning home, you will stop this week's shipment and check the timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。物品の状態も、その際に担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please also tell the responsible staff member about the item's condition then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。鉢植えという中身と相手の希望を伝え、利用できる方法を聞いてから準備します。届けば必ず元気なままとも約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 品物と相手希望を示し方法確認後に準備し状態保証を約束しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will explain that it is a potted plant and what the recipient wants, then prepare it after asking about available methods. I will not promise that it will definitely arrive in healthy condition either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the item and recipient's wishes, prepare it after checking the method, and will not promise a guaranteed condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でご相談ください。それでは、ご準備の段階で改めてお越しください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss it with us on that basis. Come back when you reach the preparation stage. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 積立について、どのようなご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like regarding regular savings contributions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎月というのは、四週間ごとという意味ですか。予定表に、四週間おきの日を書いてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 毎月を四週間ごとと理解し日程表を持参したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does monthly mean every four weeks? I have brought a schedule marked at four-week intervals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you understood monthly as every four weeks and brought a schedule. Ask about this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 暦の月ごとと、四週間の間隔は別です。どのように続けたいとお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Each calendar month and intervals of four weeks are different. How would you like to continue the contributions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 給料を受け取る月ごとに一回を考えています。日数を固定したいわけではなく、同じ月に二回する予定でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 給料を受ける暦の月ごとに一回で固定間隔ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am thinking of once in each month when I receive my salary. I do not want a fixed number of days between contributions, nor do I plan to contribute twice in one month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want once per calendar month when you receive your salary, rather than a fixed interval. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご希望として伺います。実際の設定日や取扱いは、商品ごとの説明で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will record that as your preference. Please check the actual scheduled date and handling in the explanation for each product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分の予定表がそのまま契約の設定になるとは考えず、月ごとの回数を希望として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私的予定表を契約設定とせず月ごとの回数希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will not assume my personal schedule automatically becomes the contract setting; I will state my preferred number of contributions per month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your preferred monthly frequency without treating your personal schedule as the contract setting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金額についても、ご自身で決めたい希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have a preferred amount you would like to choose yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額はまだ決めていません。月ごとの支出を確認してから考えます。日だけ話したので申込みが済んだとも思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額未決定で支出確認後に考え日程相談だけで申込み済みとしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not decided on the amount yet. I will consider it after checking my monthly expenses. I do not think that merely discussing dates means I have completed an application either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the amount is undecided, you will consider it after checking expenses, and discussing dates alone does not complete an application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日はご相談として、必要な条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today, let us check the necessary conditions as a consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。四週間の表はいったん参考にせず、暦の月ごとの希望と金額の未決定を伝えて、説明を聞いてから検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 暦の月の希望と金額未決定を示し説明後に検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. For now, I will set aside the four-week chart, explain my calendar-month preference and that the amount is undecided, and consider it after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain your calendar-month preference and undecided amount and consider it after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認しました。それでは、積立の相談担当へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed your wishes. I will now direct you to the regular-savings consultation staff. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートの金額で、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the amounts on your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お預りに二千円とあるので、今日の食費を二千円と記録しました。実際に渡した金額なら、それが代金でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: お預り二千円を食費と記録したが渡した額が代金か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says 2,000 yen under cash received, so I recorded 2,000 yen as today's food expense. If that is the amount I handed over, is it the price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the 2,000 yen shown as cash received, which you recorded as food expense, is the price because you handed it over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この会計の代金は千六百八十円です。二千円はお客様からお預かりした額で、おつりは三百二十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The price for this purchase is 1,680 yen. The 2,000 yen is the amount we received from you, and the change is 320 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三百二十円を受け取りました。戻った分を忘れて、二千円全部を使ったと書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 釣銭三百二十円を受け取ったが記録に反映しなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I received 320 yen. I forgot the money returned and wrote that I had spent all 2,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received 320 yen in change but did not reflect it in your record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代金、お預り、おつりを、それぞれの欄で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the price, cash received, and change in their respective fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。家計の食費は千六百八十円として直します。二千円を書いて、おつりの三百二十円をさらに食費へ足すこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食費を千六百八十円へ直し釣銭を追加費用として足さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will correct my household food expense to 1,680 yen. I will not write 2,000 yen and then add the 320 yen in change to the food expense as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will correct the food expense to 1,680 yen and will not add change as an additional expense. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: レシートに、ほかに読みづらい欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are any other fields on the receipt difficult to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 代金の欄の場所を確認したいです。次は一番大きい数字を代金とせず、見出しを読んで確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合計欄を尋ね最大の数値でなく見出しで確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to check where the price field is. Next time, I will read the heading to check, rather than assuming the largest number is the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where the total field is and say you will check the heading rather than the largest number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの会計合計の欄です。現金を渡した額とは分けて記録できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is this transaction-total field. You can record it separately from the cash you handed over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。千六百八十円の買物で二千円を渡し、三百二十円が戻ったと分けて理解しました。家の記録を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代金と支払額と釣銭を読み合わせて家計記録を直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see it now. I understand separately that the purchase cost 1,680 yen, I handed over 2,000 yen, and got 320 yen back. I will correct my household record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the price, amount paid, and change and correct your household record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 金額をご確認いただきありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking the amounts. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの案内について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about the notice you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分たちの読書会の案内を作りました。掲示板が空いているので貼れば、公園で集まることも認められると思ったのですが、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作読書会案内を空いた掲示板へ貼れば会場使用も認められるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We made a notice for our book club. Since the bulletin board has space, I thought posting it would also mean we were allowed to gather in the park, but I wanted to ask first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether posting your own book-club notice on an empty bulletin board would also authorize use of the venue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掲示することと、開催場所の利用は別に確認します。案内はまだ貼っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Posting a notice and using a venue need to be checked separately. Have you not posted the notice yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 貼っていません。会の内容は考えましたが、公園のどの場所を使えるかは、まだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未掲示で開催場所は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not. We have planned the club's activities, but have not yet asked which part of the park we can use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not posted it and have not confirmed the venue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会場が未確認のまま、確定した案内として出すのはお待ちください。担当へ相談する内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait before issuing a confirmed notice while the venue remains unconfirmed. Let us organize what you need to discuss with the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。案内にはまだ会場確認中と残します。日時を広める前に、場所の利用と掲示の扱いを両方聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会場確認中と記し拡散前に場所利用と掲示を両方尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will keep “venue being confirmed” on the notice for now. Before spreading the date and time, I would like to ask about both use of the location and the posting rules.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will mark the venue as being confirmed and ask about both venue use and posting before circulating the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の場所と、会の内容を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the responsible staff member your preferred location and what the club will do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本を持って少人数で話す会です。ほかの利用者を追い出すつもりではないので、使い方も相談して決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小人数読書会で他利用者を排除せず使い方を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a small group where we bring books and talk. We do not intend to drive other users away, so we will also discuss and decide how to use the space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is a small book club, you will not exclude other users, and will discuss how to use the space. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内を出せる段階になったら、必要な確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you are ready to issue the notice, we will explain the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。空いた板を見ただけで承認済みとは言わず、会場と掲示を確認してから案内を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空いた板を承認とせず会場と掲示確認後に案内を整えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not say it has been approved simply because I saw an empty board. I will finalize the notice after checking the venue and posting arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not treat an empty board as approval and will prepare the notice after checking the venue and posting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、ご相談の案内をお待ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass those details to the responsible staff member. Please wait for guidance about the consultation. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の置き場所について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about where to put your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の席が空いていたら、リュックをずっと置きたいです。自分の席を予約しているので、隣も使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一席予約で空いた隣席も荷物用に使えると思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: If the seat next to me is empty, I would like to leave my backpack there throughout the journey. Since I have reserved my own seat, I thought I could use the adjacent one too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought reserving one seat also allowed you to use an empty neighboring seat for luggage. Ask about this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の座席と、荷物を置く場所は分けて確認してください。どのようなお荷物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check your own seat and the luggage storage location separately. What sort of luggage do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このリュック一つです。隣の席も予約したわけではありません。空いているように見えるだけで、後から人が来るかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リュック一つで隣は未予約かつ後から利用者が来る可能性を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just this one backpack. I have not reserved the neighboring seat too. It only looks empty; someone might come later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have one backpack, have not reserved the adjacent seat, and acknowledge that someone may use it later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用される列車に合わせて、荷物置場や置き方を担当へご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask the responsible staff member about luggage storage areas and placement for the train you are taking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。通路へはみ出す置き方も避けたいので、大きさを見せて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路へ出ないよう大きさを示して荷物置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I also want to avoid leaving it sticking out into the aisle, so I will show its size and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show its size and ask where to put your luggage so it does not extend into the aisle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内を聞いてから、お席へお進みください。荷物の中で、手元に必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please listen to the guidance before proceeding to your seat. Is there anything in your luggage you need to keep with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 券の情報と水は手元に出します。何度も隣の席へリュックを広げずに済むよう、乗る前に整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券と水を取り出し荷物を広げる回数を減らす準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take out my ticket details and water to keep at hand. I will organize things before boarding so I do not need to keep spreading my backpack's contents over the neighboring seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take out your ticket and water and prepare to reduce how often you spread out your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で持つ物と、案内された場所に置く物を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check what you will keep with you and what you will put in the indicated place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の一席だけの予約と分かったので、隣を荷物で取っておかず、置き場所を確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 隣席を確保せず案内された置き場所を確認後に乗ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Now that I understand I reserved only my own seat, I will not hold the neighboring seat with my luggage. I will check the storage location before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not reserve the neighboring seat and will board after checking the indicated luggage location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにご確認ください。それでは、お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check as discussed. Have a safe journey.
